- Director 1 holds 67.36% of shares  

**Overview:**  
Everbright Mega Kopi Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited company incorporated on 5 August 2014 (≈12 years old) and based in Kuala Lumpur. It operates in the Food & Beverage sector, offering halal catering for corporate events and weddings. The firm’s share capital is RM 1,000,000; the largest shareholder (Director 1) controls 67.36% of the equity, and the board comprises four directors with no corporate shareholders.
